item.text: The workspace-wide all-feature check reached the examples and failed because enabling `unicache` makes the basic `Entry` derive incomplete in `kv_store_async`; that is a build-matrix limitation I’ll record separately. The new duplicate-node reproduction also confirms that `ClusterConfig::validate` accepts a “two-node” cluster containing only one distinct PID.

The audit now has 14 confirmed implementation findings. The latest additions are:

- **Duplicate node IDs are accepted.** A configuration with nodes `[1, 1]` passes validation even though it contains only one distinct server. Its configured quorum of two can never be satisfied by distinct Sequence Paxos promises: [audit_duplicate_nodes.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos/tests/audit_duplicate_nodes.rs).
- **LFU cache replication silently corrupts values.** A follower decoding the leader’s cache hit for `"A"` received `"C"` after frequency-sensitive cache eviction. A package-level test and standalone reproduction are retained. The equivalent LRU behavior passed a 160-run randomized stress test, isolating the issue to LFU state transfer.
- **Workspace all-feature compilation remains broken.** The check now reaches the examples but fails because `examples/kv_store_async/src/kv.rs` derives ordinary `Entry` while workspace feature unification enables `unicache`. This is recorded as a build-matrix limitation in the report.

All reproduction sources, retained logs, commands, affected code paths, necessary conditions, and distinctions between observed and source-traced behavior are documented in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md). The captured implementation remains unchanged.
